conference: ACS Midwest Regional Meeting (MWRM)
abstracts: 479 presented (494 numbered abstracts less 15 marked Withdrawn; numbers issued to 497), MWRM 2025 Columbia MO
spot_checks: abstract 1 'Soil health assessment in bottomland ecosystems' opens the Sunday MWRM Sci-Mix poster session
abstracts 33-36 are the Midwest Award Symposium talks, numbered in the same series as contributed papers
both pdftotext -layout and -raw return the same 494 unique IDs, the same max (497) and the same three absent numbers (168, 401, 472)
character_evidence: Open call for abstracts through ACS MAPS with a 7 July 2025 deadline (https://www.acs.org/events/regional/midwest/2025-mwrm-call-for-abstracts.html); the programme is 10 organised symposia plus 6 general sessions (analytical, biochemistry, chemical education, inorganic, organic, physical) and a Sci-Mix poster session.
programme_evidence: Counted abstract artefact settles character.
method: Rung 3, 1 search. Rung 1/2 search (`ACS Midwest Regional Meeting MWRM 2025 abstracts program book`) was used only to LOCATE the meeting site, not for a figure: it returned https://www.mwrm2025.org/. NOTE for the field notes: acs.confex.com is now NXDOMAIN (ACS has left Confex for MAPS + a per-meeting Wix site), and www.acs.org itself is behind Incapsula and returns 'Request unsuccessful. Incapsula incident ID' to curl, so the ACS-hosted call-for-abstracts page is rung-5 only. The meeting site is not: fetched https://www.mwrm2025.org/program with curl, whose 'PDF of full program' link is https://www.mwrm2025.org/_files/ugd/5ef6d9_bc377506186f4e1fa91a14d259bed12b.pdf (48pp, '2025 Midwest Regional Meeting', K. Brorsen / V. Outlaw program chairs, 12-14 Oct 2025, Memorial Union, University of Missouri). Extracted twice, `pdftotext -layout` and `pdftotext -raw`, and the two agree exactly. ACS numbers every paper sequentially through the whole programme, printed either at line start or after a time, so the count is `re.findall(r'(?:^|\s)(\d{1,4})\.\s+[A-Z(]', s, re.M)` into a set: 494 unique IDs, highest issued 497, three numbers never printed (168, 401, 472). A first pass anchored to line start only (`^\s*(\d{1,4})\.`) undercounts badly at 266, because talks inside timed symposia print as '8:00 33. <title>' - recording that trap here so the count is reproducible. EXCLUSIONS: 15 entries read 'N. Withdrawn' and are removed, giving 479 actually presented. Invited speakers are NOT separable in this artefact - ACS gives the Midwest Award Symposium lectures (33-36) numbers in the same series as contributed papers - so 479 is a slight OVERSTATEMENT of contributed orals + posters, which makes the sub-floor conclusion safer, not weaker. Language searched: English (US society). 479 is positive evidence well below the ~900 floor. NOTE: MWRM is one of eight ACS regional meetings (MARM, NERM, SERMACS, MWRM, SWRM, NORM, WRM, CERM), each with its own call; this row is MWRM only.

ratio_rationale: Only relevant if the stated figure is set aside. Pittcon calls itself a trade show and runs a 350-exhibitor expo, so the 6,000 headcount almost certainly carries exhibitor booth staff and expo-only visitors who cannot submit; the contributed call is real (20-minute oral sessions and floor posters) but it is one of several programme strands next to invited symposia, organized sessions, short courses and roundtables. I judge roughly one attendee in five to six presents contributed work, i.e. ~18%, well below a research congress and well above JASIS-style vendor-talk fairs that have no call at all. Thin evidence: no counted Pittcon edition was available to me this session, and I reasoned from the organiser's own shape (1,500+ presentations / 1,200+ speakers against 6,000 attendees, which is 25% INCLUDING invited, so contributed must sit below that).
method: NO RUNG YIELDED A COUNTED FIGURE - highest rung reached: 5 (artefact located, not countable without a browser). Zero searches. pittcon.org is WordPress and fetches fine with curl. NEXT ACTION (orchestrator, rung 5): open that Swapcard planning view and its 'Posters' tab in the browser, choose 'Continue as a guest', filter Session or Presentation = Presentation, and count presentations, excluding Session Type = Symposium (invited) and Award; count posters separately. STATED FIGURE: https://pittcon.org/conference/ states '1200+ Speakers 1500+ Presentations' and https://pittcon.org/why-attend/ repeats 1500 Presentations (counter data-value) - REPORTED BY SOURCE, NOT COUNTED; it INCLUDES invited symposia and organized sessions (the page defines the technical program as 'symposia, organized talks, oral presentations, and poster sessions'), so the contributed share is lower than 1,500 by an unknown amount. A stated total never becomes VERIFIED. RUNG 9: attendance 6,000 read off the why-attend counter (data-value="6000" under 'Attendees'), rung A3 (organiser's own promotional page; no prospectus or post-show report found at zero cost - the sitemap lists no wrap-up post), basis UNSPECIFIED (the page does not say whether exhibitor staff are inside it). Not discounted numerically because the split is not published; the discount is expressed in the judged ratio instead. Implied ~1,080 INFERRED FROM ATTENDANCE, NOT COUNTED (6,000 x 18%); orchestrator computes the final figure. TRADE-FAIR TRAP (field notes): unlike JASIS, Pittcon's 'presentations' are not vendor product talks - there is a genuine abstract call - but the headline still lumps invited symposia with contributed papers. Language searched: English (US).

programme_evidence: Counted abstract artefact settles character.
method: Rung 3, 1 search. hplc.eu (the URL carried in the phase-1 notes) is a chromatography-column vendor site, not the symposium, and hplc2025.org / hplc2026.org do not resolve - so one rung-2 search ('"HPLC 2025" International Symposium High Performance Liquid Phase Separations book of abstracts') was spent to LOCATE the artefact, which is https://hplc2025-bruges.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/250614-HPCL2025-Abstract-Book-1.pdf (530pp, 7.0MB, 'ABSTRACT BOOK', 54th edition, Bruges Meeting & Convention Centre, 15-19 June 2025). No figure was taken from the search results. Extracted twice (`pdftotext -layout`, `pdftotext -raw`). The book uses two ID schemes, both printed at the head of the abstract as '<ID> - <title>': serial prefixes PL (plenary), KN (keynote), OR (oral); and per-topic poster prefixes 2DLC, BIO, COL, DDD, DET, ENV, FOO, IM, LAR, LCMS, MD, OMI, PHA, PRE, RTM, SAP, SFC, STP. The full lecture programme is server-rendered at https://www.sepawa.com/congress/programm/vortragsprogramm/; entries parsed with `re.findall(r'(\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}) (\d{2}:\d{2}) - (\d{2}:\d{2}) - ([^|]{0,60}?) ([^|]{5,200}?) ... ([A-Z][A-Za-z]{1,6}) \| ...')` and filtered to the European Detergents Conference category: 17 EDC entries = 1 umbrella block + 12 talks + 2 breaks with poster tours + 1 'Poster Awards + Schlussworte' + (lunch) - i.e. 12 lecture slots, 4 of them 30-minute invited keynotes and 8 of them 20-minute talks. Posters: the poster page lists 20 posters with numbers up to 72 across ALL SEPAWA conference tracks; 2 carry the EDC tag (Nos. 71, 72). The page may not list every poster, so the poster figure is a floor, but the entire SEPAWA poster series tops out at 72. Contributed = 8 short talks + 2 posters = 10 (floor, since the poster list may be partial); the most generous reading, counting all 12 talk slots, is 14. Either way the EDC is a one-room, one-day meeting - positive evidence far below ~900. Languages: German and English (the SEPAWA site is bilingual; programme titles read in German).
